newsitem.title: UK: P&O eases as BZW cuts profit forecast.
newsitem.headline: P&O eases as BZW cuts profit forecast.

text.p: Shares in Peninsular and Oriental Steam Navigation Co eased on Friday as brokerage BZW cut its 1998 earnings estimate for the UK shipping group, dealers said.
By 0830 GMT, the shares were down 10p to 606-1/2p in a generally flat to firmer transportation sector.
Volume was light, with only 89,101 shares registered, which exaggerated the move, dealers said.
The analyst at BZW was not immediately available to comment on his downgrade.

Market sources said the analyst trimmed his 1998 forecast to 460 million stg from 500 million stg because of weaker margins and higher interest rate costs, among other factors, but maintained his "buy" stance. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 5106
